_meta.note: Every number the game uses. 1 crore = 1e7 INR, 1 lakh = 1e5 INR. Values are real (2025-26 rupees) unless estimate:true. The only scaling is in section 'game'. All aero tariffs exclude GST.

landing_dom_narrow_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing
landing_dom_narrow_per_t.note: No MTOW slabs in any current DEL/BOM/BLR order: DIAL splits narrow (ICAO Code A/B/C) vs wide (D/E/F). ZMI uses the DIAL card as its opening rack rate.

landing_dom_wide_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing

landing_intl_narrow_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing

landing_intl_wide_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing
landing_intl_wide_per_t.note: A380 is Code F, so wide rate applies.

landing_min_per_landing.note: Billed on next rounded-up tonne. Domestic scheduled aircraft under 80 seats exempt.

landing_mial_dom_intl_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing
landing_mial_dom_intl_per_t.note: Flat, no slabs, no wide/narrow split. Reference only.

landing_bial_dom_intl_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing
landing_bial_dom_intl_per_t.note: Falls to 295/374 from 2030-05-01. BIAL bills on nearest tonne. Reference only.

parking_contact_per_t_hr.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per hour

parking_remote_per_t_hr.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per hour

parking_free_minutes.note: 2 h free + 15 min taxi-in + 15 min taxi-out. MIAL: 2 h on-blocks to off-blocks, no taxi allowance.

parking_multipliers.unit: x base rate, hours after free period

udf_intl_biz_arr.note: Exempt: transit within 24 h on same ticket, children under 2, crew on duty, diplomats, armed forces (p.422).

udf_greenfield_opening_nmia.period: NMIA ad-hoc AERA order 2025-06-20; kept in CP1 order effective 2026-06-01
udf_greenfield_opening_nmia.note: Greenfield precedent: a new airport's UDF opens far above a mature one's. ZMI era-1 UDF starts here.

dial_yield_per_departing_pax.note: PV target revenue Rs 9,579.45 cr / 221.68 m departing pax. Total-traffic yield Rs 216.07.

dial_yield_nominal_per_pax.note: About +148%. TDSAT allowed DIAL's appeal (GMR filing 2026-09-20, https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/GMRINFRA_20092026204537_20092026-DIALTDSATORDER.pdf), so CP4 may be revised upward.

mtow_t.note: A321neo, A350, A380, 747-8I are secondary (Wikipedia). Legacy 787-9 airframes 254.7 t.

example_landing_fee.note: Arithmetic on the DIAL card and max MTOW; actual CoA MTOW may be lower.

hybrid_till_nar_share.unit: fraction of non-aero revenue deducted from aero revenue requirement
hybrid_till_nar_share.note: ARR = FRoR x RAB + D + O + T - 0.30 x NAR. DIAL/MIAL SSA: S = 30% of revenue-share-asset revenue. Before 2017: single till (1.0). Unverified Jul-2026 report of a move back toward single till: use only as a possible future shock.

control_period_years.period: AERA Act 2008 s.13; DIAL CP4 FY2025-29
control_period_years.note: Mid-period review allowed in public interest (s.13(2)). Major airport = more than 35 lakh pax/yr.

fair_return_on_equity.note: Range in AERA practice: 15.17% (HYD CP3, upheld by TDSAT 2024) to 16% (DIAL CP1/CP2).

wacc_dial_cp4.unit: % WACC (fair rate of return on RAB)

efficient_cost_of_debt.note: True-up uses lower of actual or MCLR+150 bps. Spread tied to AA- rating.

dial_rab_fy25_cr.note: Falls to 13,258.93 (FY28), 13,407.24 (FY29). Benchmark for ZMI's AERA order screen.

dial_target_revenue_cp4_cr.note: DIAL asked Rs 41,921 cr. True-up of CP3 = -852.04 cr (over-recovery refunded).

uncapitalised_project_penalty.note: AERA deducts 1% of cost for projects not capitalised on time.

sq_rebate_max_of_arr.note: Up from 4% today (1.5 obj + 2.5 subj) to 5% (4 obj + 1 subj). 0.25% per parameter group missed per month. Recovered via lower UDF in the next-but-one half-year. Draft, no final order as of Oct 2026.

sq_incentive_max.note: Offsets only rebates for parameters missed in <3 of 6 months; carries forward 6 months then expires.

del_lines_per_pax_fy25.note: Derived: retail INR 9.2 bn, F&B 3.3 bn, advertising 2.3 bn / 79.3 m pax.

hyd_per_pax_fy25.note: Derived: INR 6.3 bn / 29.5 m. Lines ~ retail 68, F&B 44, parking 27, advertising 27 (attribution from context).

bom_per_pax_fy25.note: Derived: 62% x Rs 4,571 cr / 55 m. MIAL counts cargo, ground handling, rentals as non-aero.

adani_network_per_pax_fy26.note: Ceiling reference for a mature commercial hub.

dutyfree_spp.unit: INR per passenger (GMR SPP basis, likely intl departing)
dutyfree_spp.note: Full-year FY25 figures (1,010 / 727) could not be verified.

zmi_per_pax_start.note: Anchored on HYD ~214 and BLR ~246: new hub, low intl mix.

zmi_per_pax_mature.period: era 4+ with intl >= 20% and duty-free mature
zmi_per_pax_mature.note: Between DEL 417 and BOM ~515; Adani network 672 shows headroom.

zmi_mix_share.note: From DEL/HYD line items (retail ~28%, F&B ~10-20%, advertising ~7-13%, parking ~13% at HYD); duty-free share assumed.

dwell_elasticity.unit: % change per 1% change in dwell time
dwell_elasticity.period: Wu, Morlotti & Mantin, JATM 118 (2024), 89 US airports
dwell_elasticity.note: Holds at linear and finger-pier terminals, not concourse airports.

delay_spend_shape.note: Delay raises spend up to a point, excessive delay cuts it. No threshold published.

delay_spend_peak_min.unit: minutes of delay at which spend uplift peaks
delay_spend_peak_min.note: No published threshold; 60 min chosen. Below it calm extra dwell adds spend; above it stress removes it, and a misconnect/cancel drops spend to ~0.

delay_proximity.unit: seconds near outlets per 10 min of delay
delay_proximity.note: Proximity, not spend. Most delay time does not become shopping.

satisfied_pax_shop_ratio.unit: x likelihood to shop (most vs average satisfied)
satisfied_pax_shop_ratio.note: Also +7% retail, +10% duty-free spend. Industry survey, not peer-reviewed.

transfer_vs_od_spend.unit: ratio transfer / O&D non-aero per pax
transfer_vs_od_spend.note: No primary figure. Transfers generate no parking or landside spend (~13% parking at HYD). Range 0.6 (tight D-D) to 0.9 (3h+ I-I).

opex_per_pax.unit: INR per passenger (O&M excl. revenue share)
opex_per_pax.note: Derived: Rs 1,467.01 cr / 73.67 m pax. Manpower ~40, R&M ~33, power gross ~34 (net ~9), housekeeping+hire+security ~26. CISF security is funded by the Aviation Security Fee, not operator O&M.

runway_open_per_hour.note: No published figure. ARFF ~12,200/h (90 staff x Rs 10 lakh + 5 CFT x Rs 5 cr / 15 yr) + AGL power 1,500-2,500/h + pavement/AGL 11,000-14,000/h (Rs 106.8 cr rehab every 10-12 yr + R&M). Range 24,000-29,000. ~Rs 23 cr/yr at 24x7.

atc_notional_per_hour.note: ATC is AAI's sovereign service billed to airlines (TNLC/RNFC), not the concessionaire. Charge it to the operator only if the game wants it; range 3,000-5,000.

arff_min_vehicles_cat9_10.note: Cat 9 (777-300ER) 24,300 L; Cat 10 (A380) 32,300 L water at level B.

cft_unit_cost_cr.unit: INR crore per crash fire tender
cft_unit_cost_cr.note: CP3 derived from Rs 25.10 cr for 5 CFTs (Fire Station 5 for runway 11L/29R).

runway_rehab_cr.unit: INR crore per full-length rehab programme

revenue_share_per_pax_dial.note: 0.46 x Rs 5,734 cr / 79.3 m. Larger than all O&M per pax.

hold_burn_kg_min.note: No public per-type table. Anchored on EUROCONTROL averages; +/-20% with weight and altitude.

atf_delhi_apr2026.note: Mumbai 98,247. Foreign carriers' intl uplift and non-scheduled ops: Rs 2,07,341.22/kL (+114.5%) during West Asia crisis. Centre's Rs 10,000 cr price-stabilisation advance from Jun 2026.

atf_nagpur_game.note: No published Nagpur price. Mumbai Apr-2026 98,247 + inland freight; Maharashtra VAT cut 18%->7% (15 May-14 Nov 2026) lowers it ~9.3% in that window.

atf_shock_multiplier.note: 207,341 / 96,638. Use for the 'fuel shock' era event.

hold_cost_per_min.note: kg/min / 0.80 x Rs 100/L. Borne by the airline, not the airport.

liable_party.period: CAR Sec 3 Series M Part IV, Rev. 3 (2019-02-27), amended 2023
liable_party.note: Airport owes nothing under the CAR; the airline may recover from third parties under contract/tort. ZMI's money exposure is via AERA SQ rebates and airline goodwill.

extraordinary_exempt.note: Weather, ATC, strikes, govt orders, security: no cancellation comp and no delay facilities. Refund/alternate duty remains. Not for denied boarding.

refund_option_delay_h.note: Alternate within 6 h or full refund.

cancel_comp_inr.unit: INR max per pax (or fare+fuel if lower)
cancel_comp_inr.note: Only with <24 h notice or missed same-ticket connection; plus full refund or alternate.

denied_boarding_comp_inr.unit: INR max per pax (200%/400% of fare+fuel)
denied_boarding_comp_inr.note: Connections: first-leg airline pays if final arrival >= 3 h late (3.2.3).

fog_cancel_threshold_h.note: Permissive: airlines may cancel in advance.

meal_cost_inr.note: CAR sets no amount. Range 300-500 (airport food court).

hotel_cost_inr.note: CAR sets no amount. Range 3,000-6,000 (tier-2 mid-range).

gearing_debt_share.note: Noida 65:35 (Rs 3,725 cr SBI + Rs 2,005 cr Zurich equity); Noida CA caps termination Debt Due at 70% of TPC; GHIAL/DIAL expansions 70:30; BIAL CP4 80:20; NMIA ~80:20 (inferred). Game slider 60-80%.

loan_tenor_years.note: NMIA: 23 yrs incl. construction and moratorium, maturing Dec 2044 (CRISIL Jun 2024), Rs 12,770 cr from 8 lenders.

loan_tenor_cap_fraction.note: RBI Project Finance Directions 2025 (from 2025-10-01): 85% of economic life.

loan_rate_base.note: Observed 8.7-10.2%: DAPS 9.0% (A), GHIAL NCDs 8.9-9.1% (AA+), Mopa post-COD NCD 10.0% (A), AERA benchmark 10.15% (AA-). Game: 9.5% +/- 1% by rating.

loan_rate_construction.note: Pre-COD greenfield debt is dearer: Mopa pre-COD MLDs 13.25-13.90% (small tranches) vs 10% after COD. Bank term loans undisclosed; 10.5% chosen. RBI 2025: 1% provisioning in construction vs 0.40% operational.

refi_rate_after_stability.note: GHIAL AA+ 10-yr NCDs 8.9-9.1%; BIAL AAA refinanced Rs 9,000 cr in a 15-yr NCD (Jul 2025).

dscr_covenant_min.note: GMR cargo term loan: 1.15x (ICRA Jul 2022). Tested every 6 months.

dscr_warning.note: MIAL: no distributions below 1.20x; 50% below 1.40x; 75% below 1.55x; 100% above 1.55x. ICRA downgrade trigger for BIAL/DAPS: cumulative DSCR < 1.40x.

dscr_default.unit: x DSCR (two consecutive eras -> lender step-in)
dscr_default.note: Real facilities default at the 1.10-1.15x covenant; 1.0 means operating cash cannot cover debt service at all (DSRA draw). Game uses 1.0 as the hard line, 1.10 as covenant breach.

termination_concessionaire_default.note: Before COD nothing is paid on the first 40% of TPC spent.

termination_authority_default.note: Adjusted Equity decays 0.17%/month from 4th anniversary of COD.

equity_irr_benchmark.note: Fairfax India DCF across BIAL business units; LT growth 3.5%.

equity_irr_target.note: Mid of AERA allowed CoE 15.17-16% and Fairfax 12.4-17.3%. No sponsor publishes a target IRR.

covid_force_majeure.period: award Dec 2023/Jan 2024; upheld Delhi HC 2025-03-07; DB appeal pending
covid_force_majeure.note: Use for the pandemic shock: revenue share excused ~23 months + concession extended. AAI deposited Rs 471 cr with the court.

tax_rate.source: https://incometaxindia.gov.in/ (Income Tax Act s.115BAA: 22% + 10% surcharge + 4% cess)

loss_carry_years.unit: years a business loss can be carried forward (unabsorbed depreciation: no limit)
loss_carry_years.source: https://incometaxindia.gov.in/ (Income Tax Act s.72(3) business loss 8 years; s.32(2) unabsorbed depreciation, no limit)
loss_carry_years.note: Brought-forward business loss is set off before unabsorbed depreciation. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

stage_loan_terms.source: money.json finance.loan_rate_base; bial.close.moratorium_after_cod_years (2, inferred); bial.t2.financial_close (80:20, 1 + 10 years)
stage_loan_terms.note: 1A: 4 years building + 2 moratorium + 14 repaying = 20 years door to door. 1B repays from the year after the DEL COD, as T2 did (COD FY2023, first principal FY2024). Rate for every stage: finance.loan_rate_base. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

nmia_phase1.note: FPJ: Rs 19,647 cr. News figure. 1 runway. ~Rs 983 cr/MPPA.

nmia_full.note: 'Up to Rs 1 lakh crore' is a loose verbal estimate.

nmia_capex_to_fy30_cr.note: 22,531 under way + 34,802 further. Operator proposal = upper bound.

noida_full.note: Phases 4,588/5,983/8,415/10,575 cr for 12/30/50/70 MPPA; ~Rs 422 cr/MPPA; price base unstated; Phase IV includes aerotropolis.

dwc_terminal.unit: AED bn / USD bn / INR crore / MPPA

greenfield_phase1_cr_per_mppa.note: NMIA 983; Noida 933 (838 at 10,056; 743 at 8,916). Single-runway phase 1s.

brownfield_cr_per_added_mppa.note: DEL Phase 3A 9,800/34 = 288 (incl. 4th runway); BLR T2 13,000/45 = 289; range 200-300. ZMI era expansions use this.

runway_new_hub_cr.unit: INR crore per hub runway (2025 prices)
runway_new_hub_cr.note: BLR south parallel runway L&T EPC Rs 1,358 cr (Nov 2017, incl. apron) inflated ~5%/yr. Basic 3 km runway (HAL Nashik) Rs 200 cr is the floor.

zmi_phase1_mppa.source: design.md (ZMI full build 209 MPPA; phase 2 to 260)
zmi_phase1_mppa.note: Phase 1 sized for Level 1-2 traffic: BLR ~44.5 m moves in at opening; HYD+AMD (~44 m) arrive in year 8, triggering the first expansion. Range given 60-80.

zmi_phase1_cr_per_mppa.unit: INR crore per MPPA (2025-26, excl. land)
zmi_phase1_cr_per_mppa.note: Below single-runway phase 1s (930-983) because two runways and a large headhouse spread fixed site cost over 70 MPPA; above Noida full-plan 422 (bid-era prices, ~600 inflated). Land excluded: the state contributes it.

zmi_phase1_capex_cr.note: 70 x 800 = 56,000. Cross-check: NMIA operator capex to FY30 Rs 57,333 cr; Al Maktoum ~Rs 1,112 cr/MPPA would give 77,800.

zmi_construction_years.note: NMIA ~4 yrs from Mar-2022 close to Oct-2025; Noida ~4.5 yrs from Aug-2021 close.

stages.source: design/eras.md capex.stages; money.json capex.zmi_phase1_capex_cr, capex.brownfield_cr_per_added_mppa, world.game_capacity
stages.note: Names as money-design.md: 1A = BIAL phase 1; 1B (AMD+HYD) = BIAL T1 expansion (FY2014, op year 6); 1C (BOM) + 1D (DEL) = the T2 programme (one close in year 9, 80:20, 1-yr moratorium after completion, 10-yr repayment). Used by tools/concession_model.py.

rev_share_dial.unit: fraction of gross revenue to AAI
rev_share_dial.note: Not an allowable cost in aero tariff (SSA 3.1.1).

rev_share_mial.unit: fraction of gross revenue to AAI

rev_share_mopa.unit: fraction of gross revenue to Govt of Goa

rev_share_nagpur.unit: fraction of gross revenue to MIHAN India Ltd
rev_share_nagpur.note: GMR's original bid was 5.76%, raised to 14.49% after negotiation (SC judgment 2022-05-09). The real Nagpur comparator.

rev_share_nmia.unit: fraction of gross revenue to CIDCO

ppf_aai_2019.note: International pax pay 2x; indexed annually to CPI-IW (https://www.itln.in/adani-to-takeover-ahmedabad-lucknow-and-mangaluru-airports-for-50-years-aviation). 50-year leases.

ppf_noida.unit: INR per passenger to the state (YIAPL)

state_stake_precedent.note: ZMI's 20% state stake (AAI 10% + state 10%) is below the 26% norm (game choice).

madc_role.value: Maharashtra Airport Development Company: Govt of Maharashtra company that spearheads MIHAN; holds 51% of MIHAN India Ltd (AAI 49%), which owned/ran Nagpur airport and awarded GMR its 30-yr concession
madc_role.period: 2006 MoU; SC judgment 2022-05-09; GMR took over 2026-06-25
madc_role.note: Role verified, so 'MADC' may be named as the state's 10% partner. MADC does not run the airport itself (MIL did, GMR now does); say 'MADC, the State of Maharashtra's airport and MIHAN developer'.

fairfax_bial_stake.note: Brief's 74% includes the 10% Siemens stake bought for USD 255 m; Fairfax AR reports 64% held at 2024-12-31 with the Siemens 10% purchase setting the price; AAI/KSIIDC 13% each per the brief (not re-verified).

revenue_per_pax.note: Derived: DEL 7,568 cr / 78.7 m; BLR 4,239 cr / 44.5 m; BOM 4,571 cr / 55 m.

ebitda_margin.note: BOM derived: PBILDT 1,599 / TOI 4,021 (CARE). DEL and BOM margins are after 46% / 38.7% revenue share; BLR's modest revenue share explains ~70%.

bial_valuation.note: USD 2.55 bn from Fairfax (Siemens 10% for USD 255 m, DCF-supported); INR at ~85.5/USD is my conversion (estimate). BIAL ROE 14% (2024).

peak_day_to_annual.note: Derived from reported figures: 78.7 m (FY26) / 2.53 lakh (record day 30 Nov 2025). Peak day is 1.17x the average day. ATM equivalent: 455,169 / 1,392 = 327.

design_day_movements_by_level.unit: movements on a peak day for the traffic moved in
design_day_movements_by_level.source: build.md (BLR record 837, HYD 607, BOM 1,036) ; https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/GMRINFRA_15122025214736_15122025-monthlytrafficdataNov.pdf (DEL 1,414 on 22 Dec 2025)
design_day_movements_by_level.note: AMD ~300 is an estimate (13.4 m pax/yr). L1 BLR; L2 +HYD+AMD; L3 +BOM; L4 +DEL.

shift_to_day.note: A shift samples part of the peak day; scale its money to the whole day by movements.

annualise.value: annual = shift_money x shift_to_day x peak_day_to_annual; era = 5 x annual (growth applied per year)

shift_money_multiplier.note: No inflation needed: a Level-1 shift (~110 movements, ~16,500 pax) is already ~Rs 1 crore of revenue, and single calls swing Rs 0.3-5 lakh. Keep real rupees; if tuning needs more bite, raise this one number and show it in the UI.

financial_close.note: Default gearing 70:30; slider 60-80%. Repayment: sculpted (default) or equal instalments.

opening_tariff.note: Greenfield UDF precedent (NMIA); AERA resets it each era from RAB x 15.41% RoE (WACC 12.89%) less 30% of non-aero.

cpi.note: Same as design/eras.md game.cpi. VSI is modelled in nominal rupees, game year 1 = FY2026 prices. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

demand_elasticity.unit: -(% change in traffic) / (% change in average fare)
demand_elasticity.source: https://www.iata.org/en/iata-repository/publications/economic-reports/estimating-air-travel-demand-elasticities---by-intervistas/ (InterVISTAS for IATA 2007: national-level price elasticity about -0.8)
demand_elasticity.note: Applied to the aero charge above the market norm, as a share of the fare. Caps demand at the premise; never raises it. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

avg_fare.source: https://www.goindigo.in/information/investor-relations.html (IndiGo FY2025 yield ~Rs 4.96 per RPK x ~1,050 km average stage)
avg_fare.note: Derived: yield x stage length. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

airline_relations_drag.unit: traffic growth per year (fraction) in every year of a control period where the tariff is pushed hard
airline_relations_drag.source: design estimate; precedent: IATA, FIA and BAR objections to BIAL CP3/CP4 (https://www.aera.gov.in/uploads/stack_holder/17841244347199.pdf)
airline_relations_drag.note: Airlines add capacity elsewhere when the hub fights for a front-loaded tariff. Compounds into the demand level. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

soft_push_carry.unit: fraction of PV(ARR) carried in the T2-analog CP when the player asks AERA for a gentle tariff
soft_push_carry.source: design estimate (between CP3's 13.9% and a full deferral)

renewal_share.unit: renewal capex as a share of depreciation; ramps linearly from start at opening to full after one asset life
renewal_share.source: design/eras.md game.renewal_share (0.25 at opening); full replacement once assets reach the end of their AERA life (handback standard: money.json world.residual_life_thresholds)
renewal_share.note: Deducted from CFADS and capitalised into RAB. Keeps the asset base from decaying in the late game. Not applied in the back-test (BIAL RAB anchors already include it). Used by tools/concession_model.py.

lbc_dscr_target.unit: x base-case CFADS / debt service the bank sculpts and sizes to
lbc_dscr_target.source: design/eras.md section 7 (game.lbc_dscr_target); BIAL covenant context: money.json bial.debt.covenants (1.40 cumulative downgrade trigger, 1.5 expected)

lbc_interest_only_cover.unit: x base-case CFADS / interest the bank requires in interest-only years after COD
lbc_interest_only_cover.source: money.json game.dscr_thresholds.warning (1.20): the bank does not close on a base case that sits in its own warning zone; BIAL's opening year ran at about 1.07 (money.json bial.path.dscr FY2009, est.), which its lenders had not foreseen
lbc_interest_only_cover.note: Below this the bank cuts the stage's gearing. Binds only in the opening year, so the expert's later warnings cannot come from the debt's shape. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

ops_profiles.note: Stand-ins for what the sample-day shifts report. Poor and lazy get worse as the levels get harder; their values are hand-set design estimates. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

pax_per_movement_by_level.source: design/eras.md section 3 (game.pax_per_movement x LV wide share)

move_in_years.unit: game year each level's traffic moves in

capacity_headroom.unit: x capacity that can be served

nar_convergence.unit: share of the gap to the mature Mall yield closed per era, x Q

land_rent.unit: INR crore a year (FY2026 prices) paid to the state for the land
land_rent.source: money-design.md (the state leases the land at a nominal rent); money.json bial.ssa.land (BIAL: 4,008 acres; rent recovers the state's site cost, cap raised to Rs 302.15 cr in 2024)
land_rent.note: Nominal = the design. BIAL-style = BIAL's site-cost cap x the traffic factor 5, recovered over 30 years at 9.5% (est.). Not in the ARR (BIAL's land rent is not an aero cost in the building block, est.). Used by tools/concession_model.py.

state_loan_defer_from_year.unit: game year of the 1C/1D (T2-style) financial close, from which the state loan may be deferred
state_loan_defer_from_year.source: money.json bial.ssa.state_loan (350) / bial.close.project_cost_final (2,470.29); bial.ssa.state_loan_repayment, bial.ssa.state_loan_deferral (from 2018, during the T2 programme), bial.ssa.state_loan_in_wacc
state_loan_defer_from_year.note: BIAL deferred its state loan at the T2 programme (bial.ssa.state_loan_deferral). Used by tools/concession_model.py.

refi_trigger.unit: years with lender DSCR >= stable_dscr after the last mandatory COD
refi_trigger.note: BIAL's 2025 AAA NCD: 8.15%, 15 years, 2-year moratorium (finance.refi_rate_after_stability 9.0% is the AA+ class; a project that has met its covenants for 3 years refinances as BIAL did). Trigger: 3 years after the last mandatory COD with no lender warning (DSCR >= 1.20), as BIAL refinanced 2 years after T2. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

covid_sensitivity_years.unit: game years that take BIAL FY2021 and FY2022 traffic ratios (sensitivity only)
covid_sensitivity_years.source: money.json bial.path.pax_m (FY2021 / FY2020, FY2022 / FY2020); finance.covid_force_majeure (fee excused)
covid_sensitivity_years.note: BIAL's COVID years placed on VSI years 16-17. Sensitivity row only; the lenders' base case does not foresee it. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

_note.value: World layer: shocks, valuation, handback, termination, regulation abroad, incidents, growth
_note.note: Skeptic corrections applied. Keys prefixed game_ are game estimates calibrated to the sourced keys. FX for game conversion: fx_inr.

covid_global_2020_multiplier.note: The -64.2% figure is vs a pre-COVID forecast, not 2019 actual (skeptic S1).

covid_india_fy22_share.note: AAI estimate; recovery to pre-COVID by FY24 unverified.

covid_hub_drops.note: LHR 22.1m vs ~80.1m base, lowest for decades (not since 1975).

fm_precedent_mial.note: Corrects claims that this case is DIAL. finance.covid_force_majeure (DIAL, from ICRA) left unchanged; its dates are not confirmed by this judgment.

covid_rab_uplift_lhr.note: CMA found CAA not wrong. Regulator relief is partial.

collapse_kingfisher_2012.note: Decline broke ~3 years of growth ("35 months" unconfirmed).

collapse_jet_2019.note: Last flights night of 17 Apr. Fare rise is Mar 2019 vs Sep 2018.

airline_lien_wow.note: Isavia held a leased A321 under statutory lien.

fuel_spike_2022.note: Peak ~170 secondary; $222bn extra bill unverified (skeptic S11).

airspace_india_2025.note: Corrected from 9-15 May (skeptic S15). Ban duration to Apr 2026 unverified.

heathrow_blocks.note: 14.3x unverified; 11.7x derived (EV ~26bn / 2,228m). Per-share price flat over 14 months.

bial_implied_multiple.note: Equity Rs 21,800 cr + net debt ~4x EBITDA, EBITDA ~Rs 3,050 cr.

bial_ladder.note: AAI and KSIIDC 13% each; concession to 2068. Value 2.55x in ~8 years.

bial_control_path_premium.note: Premium sat on one block, not the whole stake.

mial_rofr_2019.note: GVK matched at same price via ROFR. Rs 11,200 cr counter-claim not found.

galeao_2025.note: Buyout only if no rival bidder emerges in a share auction.

mca_handback.note: Clauses 39.2, 39.3.2, 39.6.1, 40.1, 40.2.1-3, 17.8.1, 17.9.1 verbatim. Caveat: ropeway MCA, same template family.

value.ld_per_day: avg daily profit of last 3 years

renewal_precedents.note: Hyderabad verified; MIAL years 20-24 no-default condition and NAIA unverified.

damepl.note: Termination payout can be annulled a decade later.

lender_substitution_highway.note: Highway precedent; no Indian airport case.

viracopos.note: Filing month and 2025 relicitacao status/indemnity unverified.

value.indemnity: unamortised reversible assets minus fines and arrears

h7_wacc.note: Corrected range (skeptic). 8.32% is top of CoE range.

tdsat_single_till_2025.note: Rs 50,000 cr burden, UDF ranges and SC appeal unverified.

ebitda_margins_world.note: Fraport 33% on EUR 3.89bn ex-IFRIC12 (not 29.4%). Changi/ADP derived.

fraport_build_era.note: Net debt EUR 8,388.5m not on source page.

inc_drone_gatwick.note: Airport loss is a spokesman estimate.

inc_muan.note: Partly localizer/pavement works and Gwangju consolidation, not only the accident.

inc_bird_strikes.note: 2023 revised to 19,628 (Report 31); cost and 2024 figure unverified.

bom_capacity_cut.note: Reason: excessive slot allocation and poor slot adherence.

india_growth_forecasts.note: Gov implied CAGR derived. Boeing/Airbus/taper unverified.

rofr_radius_dial.note: 10% match window not in this source (Noida ROFR within 10% is in ppp.concession_terms).

game_shocks.note: Calibrated to world.* history; at most 2 negative shocks per era.

game_stake_pricing.note: EV = EBITDA x multiple x (1 - 1.075^-yearsLeft); equity = EV - net debt.

game_traffic_growth.note: 412m x factors ~ 1.1bn by 2046, consistent with gov ~1bn by 2047.

game_incidents.note: grid buy cost is a game estimate; routine incidents automated per ZMI feedback.

inr_usd_depreciation.unit: fraction per year (INR weakening against USD)
inr_usd_depreciation.source: https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/ReferenceRateArchive.aspx (RBI reference rate ~65 INR/USD in 2017 to ~86 in 2025)
inr_usd_depreciation.note: Recalled, not fetched. Converts Fairfax India's USD return on BIAL to rupees: (1.11 x 1.036) - 1 = 15.0%. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

_note.value: BIAL (Bengaluru, Kempegowda): the calibration airport for ZMI's money model
_note.note: Nominal INR crore of the year shown unless stated. FY2009 = Apr 2008-Mar 2009. Skeptic corrections applied. Delhi/Navi Mumbai are comparison rows only (research/bial.md section 8). Supersedes world.bial_ladder rows marked unverified (2018 now confirmed; 2023 is a single 10% block).

date.note: Award Oct 2001; GoI CA signed 5 Jul 2004; close Jun 2005 (28 Jun per GVK); 30-month build from Jul 2005; opened 24 May 2008 (~3 years close to COD).

opening_date.note: HAL airport closed to commercial traffic at opening.

project_cost_redesign.note: Mid-build redesign 4.5 to 11.4 mppa; increase funded by extra lender debt.

project_cost_final.note: Includes Rs 540 cr extension works (equity plus debt). +75% on close cost for 2.5x capacity: template for a phase-1 resize funded by extra debt.

senior_debt.note: ~52% of Rs 1,412 cr. ICICI arranger and sole lender (to syndicate); fully non-recourse; no completion guarantees; a further ~USD 20 m loan sized to final cost. Rate, moratorium and DSRA at close not disclosed.

capital_mix.unit: fraction of Rs 1,412 cr close cost
capital_mix.note: 736 / 350 / 326 cr. Senior:(senior+equity) 69% sits inside ZMI's 60-75% gearing slider.

equity_cr.note: Share capital Rs 384.6 cr by FY2010 (B.PAC Table 4).

balance_sheet_fy2010_fy2011.note: Senior debt / (equity + state loan) 1.92 then 1.79. ~Rs 96 cr fall in FY2011 is first principal mixed with ECB FX restatement, consistent with a ~2-year post-COD moratorium (inference).

moratorium_after_cod_years.note: Not disclosed at close. Inferred: no principal reduction in FY2009-10, first fall in FY2011.

state_loan.note: GoK soft loan under the State Support Agreement; not fully drawn on day one; SBI letter of credit guaranteed the state commitment at ICICI's request. 25% of the close cost.

state_loan_deferral.note: Karnataka Cabinet 22 Jun 2018. ICRA: 'additional cushion for debt servicing in second and third control periods' (the T2 build). B.PAC gives 333.5. Template for a state-support lever that defers at the expansion.

state_loan_in_wacc.unit: cost and weight in AERA WACC
state_loan_in_wacc.note: Consultation Table 25 weight 6.22%; decided Table 26 6.40%. A 0% tranche lowers allowed return and tariffs.

land.note: Rent amount not found; 'token rent' not confirmed. 2024: lease made coterminous with 2068; site-cost cap raised from ~Rs 212 cr to max Rs 302.15 cr; 6% annual rent escalation from May 2038 is unverified. Rent appears to recover the state's land cost. iupindia (2005) said 3,800 acres.

land_site_cost_cap.unit: INR crore (maximum site cost the land rent recovers, 2024)
land_site_cost_cap.note: Raised from about Rs 212 cr. Used by tools/concession_model.py for the BIAL-style land-rent sensitivity.

concession_fee.unit: fraction of gross revenue to GoI
concession_fee.note: CA clause 3.3. AERA includes only 4% of aero revenue in the ARR (hybrid till). Compare DIAL 45.99% (ppp.rev_share_dial).

aai_role.note: AAI CNS/ATM; government agencies for customs, immigration, security, met. AAI and GoK nominees on the board (ICRA).

t1_expansion.note: Opening capacity 11.5 mppa; debottlenecked later to 26.5 mppa (ICRA 2019).

refi_2016.note: Refinanced 8 years after opening to lengthen maturity before T2. ICRA AA- (Jun 2017) to AA (Aug 2017). CP2 actual cost of debt 9.06% (decided Table 26; 9.11% consultation).

refi_2025_ncd.note: Unlisted AAA NCDs (ISIN INE888G07113), SBICAPs sole arranger; back-ended repayment. Coupon ~8.15% per Reuters/Fairfax. Fixed vs 'variable index-linked' conflict between BIAL release and ICRA annexure. Moratorium was 7 yrs in the Sep 2024 plan (ICRA id=130057), 2 yrs by May 2025 (id=134917). Template for refinance after stable years.

dsra.note: DSR plus margin money Rs 459 cr at 31 Mar 2026 vs Rs 3,603.3 cr unencumbered cash. CRISIL says six months.

covenants.note: BIAL told AERA an ARR under-recovery could breach expansion-loan covenants (AERA Order 11/2021-22 p.160).

value.order: MoCA ad hoc; trued up later

value.trueup_note: trued up on 30% till at 10.97%, at Mar 2016
over-recovery PV at Mar 2022, mainly from late T2 capitalisation
under-recovery PV at Mar 2027 (net ARR 8,961.95 vs actual 8,612.22)

control_periods.unit: per control period (INR crore, %, INR per pax)
control_periods.note: CP2 first-year UDF conflict: BPAC/AERA 100/400 from 16 Sep 2018 (67% cut) vs ICRA/Deccan Herald 139/558 (55%). TDSAT interim collections ~101.91 cr (AERA) vs ~75 cr (ICRA). CP1 order came 3 yrs late, CP2 ~2.4 yrs late; old rates charged meanwhile and trued up.

precp_shortfall.note: 54.87 at Mar 2011, indexed at 10.97% (x1.68) to 92.33 at 2016, then 11.74% (x1.95): x3.3 over 11 years. The carrying-cost mechanism. BIAL had claimed 411.09 indexed at Mar 2011; unindexed 357.59.

fy2009_arr_vs_actual.note: AERA counted only from 1 Sep 2009 (when it existed): net over-recovery 83.28. Precedent: no true-up before the regulator exists.

cp1_till_and_return.note: 40%-vs-single-till UDF gap ~Rs 116.14 cr treated as a passenger transfer for capex, adjusted from RAB in CP2. Later trued up on 30% till at 10.97%: over-recovery 313.62 at Mar 2016. TDSAT (Dec 2020) upheld hybrid till.

cp2_trueup_over_recovery.unit: INR crore (PV at 31 Mar 2022, deducted from FY2022 ARR)
cp2_trueup_over_recovery.note: Collections 4,263.12 vs trued-up ARR 3,906.08; FY17 alone 597.25; PV factors 1.74 down to 1.12. Cause: T2 capitalised later than the tariff assumed. BIAL claimed a 4,886 cr under-recovery (litigation). CP4 nets with pre-control to 794.38.

cp3_wacc.note: CoE from IIM Bangalore CAPM: beta 0.93, Rf 7.56%, ERP 8.06%. BIAL asked CoE 23.61%, CoD 10%.

cp3_rab_t2_step.note: 2.2x in two years as T2 entered at COD.

cp3_arr_and_shortfall.note: Deliberate smoothing: back-loaded tariff with the shortfall carried to CP4 at FRoR. 13.9% is PV/PV (10.6% would wrongly divide by nominal ARR).

cp3_trueup_shortfall.unit: INR crore under-recovery into FY2027 ARR (PV at 31 Mar 2027, 11.77%)
cp3_trueup_shortfall.note: Gross ARR 11,045.83, less NAR 1,289.51, less 794.38 = 8,961.95 vs actual 8,612.22. Consultation stage 239.1.

cp4_wacc.note: CoD trued up at lower of actual or MCLR+50bps. IATA push to lower CoE rejected.

cp4_baseline_arr.note: The building block in its plainest form.

cp4_incremental_arr.note: Tariff steps on commissioning, by addendum; nothing pre-funded during construction.

asked_vs_allowed.note: Ratios are my arithmetic. Basis for appeal odds.

cp1_order_building_block.unit: INR crore over CP1 FY2012-16 / m pax
cp1_order_building_block.note: 40% shared revenue till. O&M is the whole airport's (the till deducts 40% of non-regulated revenue), unlike CP3's aero-allocated O&M. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

useful_life_rule.value: assets commissioned from FY2018 depreciate over longer AERA useful lives
useful_life_rule.source: AERA Order 35/2017-18 (determination of useful life of airport assets), https://aera.gov.in/
useful_life_rule.note: Order number recalled, not re-fetched. The model fits one life to pre-FY2018 assets (CP1 depreciation) and one to later assets (CP3 depreciation). Used by tools/concession_model.py.

order_lag_months.unit: months of the first CP year billed at the old tariff
order_lag_months.source: money.json bial.aera.control_periods: CP2 order 31 Aug 2018 effective 16 Sep 2018 (5.5 months); CP3 order 28 Aug 2021 effective Oct 2021 (6); CP4 order 20 Aug 2026 effective 1 Sep 2026 (5)
order_lag_months.note: Mean of BIAL's three building-block orders. VSI CP1 is ordered before opening (Navi Mumbai precedent), so CP1 has no lag. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

fy.note: Index for every path array. null = not published.

pax_m.note: FY2009 is 312 days (8.45 annualised). FY2021 AAI actual (BIAL said 8.00). FY2024 derived (+18% on 31.9). Traffic exceeded the 20 mppa capacity from FY2017. FY2013 -5.7% (domestic -8.1%; Kingfisher collapse inferred).

aero_rev_cr.note: FY2009-16 are AERA's proposed true-up figures. CP2 (FY2017-21) published only as a total: 4,263.12.

op_income_cr.note: FY2009 is an estimate (aero 241 + non-aero ~83). FY2020-22 CRISIL revenue; FY2023-25 ICRA consolidated; FY2026 ICRA (~+15% on 3,699 text basis). FY2024 ICRA text says 2,539. FY2025 includes ~272 one-off land income.

nonaero_cr.source: derived: op_income_cr - aero_rev_cr (FY2009 from AERA 40% NAR deduction 33.33/0.4)
nonaero_cr.note: Mixed bases (AERA aero vs company OI); rough.

ebitda_cr.note: FY2014-17 reported; FY2018-19, FY2023-26 derived as margin x OI; FY2009 estimate (range 128-160).

ebitda_margin.note: All reported except FY2009 (estimate 0.40-0.46). FY2021-22 not published (collapse).

interest_cr.note: FY2009 estimate 130-140; FY2020 estimate (IC 4.69 at FY2019-like margin); FY2026 assumed near FY2025 after refi at 8.15%.

principal_cr.note: Reported: FY2020 ~37, FY2025 ~513. FY2011 ~96 includes FX restatement. FY2019 ~6 derived from DSCR 5.6. FY2024 estimate 250-400 (CRISIL: T2 loans 10,206 to 9,718 by Nov 2024). FY2026 estimate 300-460 (462 pre-refi schedule).

dscr.note: Only FY2019 (5.6x, ICRA) is reported. Ranges: FY2009 1.0-1.15; FY2021 <0.5; FY2022 1.1-1.2; FY2023 ~2.0 (<=2.3); FY2024 1.3-1.5; FY2025 1.55-1.7; FY2026 2.0-2.25. Lender CFADS would be lower (tax, maintenance capex).

fy2009_first_year.note: BIAL's own statements quoted by AERA. Intl UDF 1,070 from AOD.

covid.note: ICRA AA put on Negative and withdrawn 8 Oct 2020. FY2021 is the only reported sub-1.0x year.

post_t2.note: Leverage peak FY2023 (9.4x, T2 opens); coverage trough FY2024 (1.9x, T2 repayment starts); recovery FY2025 on the CP3 tariff step. Implied debt is derived.

t2_dscr_warning.note: ICRA 2019: 'suppressed projected debt coverage metrics expected in third control period'; BIAL to AERA: under-recovery would mean defaulting on loan covenants under the expansion financing agreements. The real lender-warning point.

cy2025_fairfax.note: Non-aero plus other operating income (incl. real estate) now exceeds aero.

ebitda_basis.unit: R reported / D derived from a reported margin x operating income / E estimate

financial_close.note: Floating, 1-yr MCLR linked. Later syndicated (SBI 2,951, Canara 2,481, Union 1,905, Axis 1,429, BoM 952; all to 30 Sep 2034; CRISIL Nov 2024). ICRA calls the split debt:internal accruals 4:1. SBI had funded ~500 cr of runway earthworks before close.

capex_actual.note: 15% under the 13,352 close budget. Balance expected in CP4 RAB.

cp2_approved_capex.note: ~14% disallowance risk at approval, reviewed on actuals.

cp2_udf_cut_and_tdsat.note: Regulator does not pre-fund the expansion; cash in construction comes from the old base and lenders.

deferred_package.note: T2 Ph1 4,579.32; landside Ph1b 1,495.65; MMTH 537.34; apron Ph2 447.17; south runway Ph2 286.56; utilities 67.48; maintenance 45.05. IDC capitalised into RAB.

delay_penalty_rule.unit: fraction of project cost off ARR if capitalisation slips; no further IDC
delay_penalty_rule.note: TDSAT upheld 16 Dec 2020. Waived to 31 Mar 2022 for COVID; T2 capitalisation moved to Dec 2022; ~50 cr extra PMC after Mar 2021 disallowed.

timeline.note: Slip months is my arithmetic (Mar 2021 to Jan 2023).

delay_causes.unit: [actual, planned share delivered, months impact] by May 2020
delay_causes.note: COVID labour and imported long-lead items; accepted by AERA; no passenger inconvenience since traffic collapsed.

unit_costs.unit: INR crore per added mppa / INR per sqm
unit_costs.note: 456 is nominal FY2017-24; 286 is FY2025 prices; not like-for-like.

next_programme.note: MECON is the consultant's assessment, not AERA's final determination.

zmi_1b_template.note: Mechanisms copied from BIAL's T2; numbers to be scaled in tools/concession_model.py.

value.note: announced 5 Oct 2009; Zurich kept 5% and board seat; operator to 2015
after Siemens lock-in ended Jun 2011 (~3 yrs post-COD); GVK 43% largest, not majority
premium to buy out an exiting sponsor (38 to 48%), not control
48 to 54%: the majority block, at about fair value
ratchet to 15% if Anchorage IPO < USD 1.0 bn; long-stop 16 Sep 2026
64 to 74%; Siemens out 20 yrs after close

ladder.note: Implied 100% values are derived (2009/2011 INR from share count 384.6 m; USD from CAPA). Mar 2017 to Dec 2025 ~13.3% a year in USD.

shareholding_path.note: Fairfax 74% = 43.6% via Anchorage + 30.4% direct (69.0% fully diluted after OMERS).

lockin.note: The '51% for 7 years' rule is from later AAI PPP norms, not BIAL.

fairfax_return.note: A real sponsor return to compare with the game's equity IRR target (15.5%).

dividends.unit: USD million cumulative interest and dividends to Fairfax (2017-2025)
dividends.note: Ring-fenced cash and restrictive dividend covenants: cash went to capex and deleveraging.

dcf_inputs.note: 2025 revisions: higher CP4/CP5 capex (T2 Ph2, T3), higher UDFs from CP5 on a higher RAB.

airport_city.note: BACL 100% SPV: hotel, business park, arena, convention centre, Air India and IndiGo MROs. Value cut in 2025 as land went to airport capex.

traffic_factor.note: Opening: ZMI ~44.5 m (BLR moves in) vs BIAL 8.45-9.93 m = 4.5-5.3x. Mature: ZMI L4 ~220 m vs BIAL FY2026 44.5 m = ~5.0x.

capacity_factor.source: derived: ZMI 45 / 209 mppa (money-design.md) vs BIAL 11.4 / 51.5 mppa

capex_factor_real.source: derived: bial.close.project_cost_final, bial.debt.t1_expansion, bial.t2.capex_actual deflated by WPI; capex.zmi_full_build_capex_cr
capex_factor_real.note: WPI ratios approximate (FY2008 x2.07, FY2013 x1.45, FY2017-24 x1.15), from memory, not fetched from eaindustry.nic.in.

rab_per_pax_warning.note: ZMI 1A is ~1.8x more capital per passenger than BIAL's phase 1. Close the gap with heavier smoothing, a smaller 1A, or the state-support loan; no hidden multiplier.

time_alignment.note: Opening arc maps year n to n+4; the T2 arc is compressed because BOM/DEL arrive by year 14.

cpi_india_fy.unit: % y/y consumer inflation by fiscal year
cpi_india_fy.source: https://www.mospi.gov.in/ (CPI-IW to FY2013, CPI-Combined after); RBI Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, Table "Consumer Price Index"
cpi_india_fy.note: Recalled, not fetched; used only to put BIAL opex and non-aero per pax in FY2026 rupees. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

opening_cost_fit.unit: which BIAL years fit the opening-cost term
opening_cost_fit.source: money.json bial.path (op_income_cr, ebitda_cr), bial.debt.t1_expansion (11.4 -> 20 mppa, FY2014)
opening_cost_fit.note: Opening premium = k x the fixed O&M of newly commissioned capacity. Greenfield k fitted to FY2009 (one point; year 2 at half, est., FY2010 opex not published); expansion k fitted to FY2014-15 (T1, years 1 and 2). T2 (FY2023-24) is the out-of-sample check. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

t2_draw_shares.unit: share of the T2 loan drawn by FY
t2_draw_shares.source: design estimate; works FY2017-23 (money.json bial.t2.timeline), balance FY2020-23 (bial.t2.funding_split)

vintage_shares_fy17_21.unit: share of FY2017-21 aero RAB additions by FY
vintage_shares_fy17_21.source: design estimate; 45% in FY2020 for the south runway (first landing 19 Mar 2020, money.json bial.t2.timeline)
vintage_shares_fy17_21.note: The total is solved from AERA's opening FY2022 RAB; only the timing is assumed. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

fc_fy2021.unit: m pax AERA would have forecast for FY2021 before COVID
fc_fy2021.source: design estimate: FY2020 actual 32.36 m x ~1.05
fc_fy2021.note: Used only in the CP2 plan (ordered Aug 2018, before COVID). Used by tools/concession_model.py.

forward_growth.unit: traffic growth per year after FY2026 in the back-test sculpt weights

p1_repayment.source: money.json bial.close.senior_debt (12-year rupee loan from close, FY2006), bial.path.principal_cr (first principal FY2011)
p1_repayment.note: 12-year tenor less 3 years of construction. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

cp1_trueup_wacc.unit: % at which AERA trued up the pre-control period and CP1
cp1_trueup_wacc.source: money.json bial.aera.control_periods (CP1 trueup_note: "trued up on 30% till at 10.97%")

t2_capitalised_months.unit: months of FY2023 before T2's COD (interest capitalised)
t2_capitalised_months.note: 1 Apr 2022 to 15 Jan 2023. Used by tools/concession_model.py.

refi16_early_principal.unit: INR crore principal on the 2016 refinancing before the sculpted profile
refi16_early_principal.source: money.json bial.path.principal_cr (FY2019 6, FY2020 37; estimate flag set)
